normalStartup.storageConclusion: settings.json changed during execution: WindowMaximized True to False and previously absent SeenContextHints to 0. Only that file was restored from this run fresh byte backup after allowed-field/hash/locking checks. Final full snapshot equals the pre-run snapshot; do not describe the run as byte-unchanged or zero-restoration.
limits: Startup/process/window evidence only; no human playthrough, gameplay interaction or screenshot produced by this script. Root performs the actual window capture separately.
WindowDisplayController can change settings at startup/exit. This is reported as changed-and-restored, never falsely byte-unchanged during execution.

Only settings.json and settings.json.bak can be restored, after complete user-file comparison and exclusive-lock current/backup hash checks. Campaign, unknown setting fields, added/deleted files and unrelated changes fail without automatic overwrite.
No power-loss atomicity across two settings files; a write error fails and preserves all evidence/backups. No previous process is ever terminated.
